name: volcano_rumble
description: deep sub rumble with slow swells, a pitched groan and three distant deep thumps; phone-audible harmonics 70–280 Hz; seamless loop

name: lava_crackle
description: bubbling, glugging molten rock with crackling, ticking crust over a low molten roar; seamless loop

name: lava_glug
description: thick viscous lava bubble pop (at 0) + two smaller glugs (0.42, 0.78 s) and molten splats

name: bomb_whistle
description: falling bomb whistle 1.75 kHz → 360 Hz with crescendo and air rush; hard stop at 1.2 s (= where the explosion hits)

name: explosion_big
description: huge layered explosion: shock crack + pitched sub thump + boom + blast roar + fireball, stones and gravel raining down (0.2–2 s), canyon echoes, long dark tail

name: explosion_mid
description: mid-size explosion (bomb hitting lava): crack + boom + short debris rain + echo

name: explosion_far
description: distant, muffled explosion: soft low thud, rolling thunder-like rumble, terrain echoes (no crack)

name: biplane_flyby
description: 1930s biplane, 9-cyl radial engine + prop beat + wire whistle; physically modelled overhead pass (doppler drop, ground-reflection flanging, left → right) closest at 1.4 s

name: biplanes_formation
description: formation of three biplanes (firing 128 / 134 / 140 Hz → audible beating), staggered overhead passes at ≈1.7 / 1.95 / 2.25 s, left → right

name: whoosh_fast
description: fast air whoosh with doppler drop, pans left → right; peak at 0.2 s

name: whoosh_big
description: big heavy whoosh: wide band sweep + low body + sub drop + flutter, pans left → right; peak at 0.45 s (camera moves, globe spins)

name: whoosh_rev
description: reverse swell (reversed noise sweep + chord + reverb) sucking into a hard cut at 0.7 s

name: crash_zoom
description: crash-zoom: rising swish + zoom whine into a low punchy thump at 0.40 s

name: swish_short
description: short airy swish with paper friction (panels / text sliding in)

name: hit_impact
description: punchy cinematic hit: crack + pitched sub thump + body + faint low ring + room (text slams, reveals)

name: stamp
description: rubber stamp slam on paper over a wooden desk (short air, slam, desk ring, lift)

name: pin_drop
description: map pin landing: short boomy thock (wood + sub) with a tiny metallic ring

name: glitch_hit
description: digital glitch hit: bit-crushed impact, accelerating pitched stutter, data chirps, tape-stop tail

name: sparkle_ding
description: bright positive ding: two bell notes E6 → B6 + glittering sparkle pings + shimmer + reverb

name: tynts
description: comedic "ba-dum-tss" button: high tom (0) + low tom (0.14) + bright light cymbal & tiny kick (0.30)

name: ui_click
description: [extra · S08 «клик-план»] crisp mechanical click

name: counter_tick_loop
description: rapid mechanical counter ticks, 20 per second, alternating pitch (rolling numbers); seamless loop

name: clock_tick_fast
description: fast suspense clock: tick-tock at 5 per second (10 strokes); seamless loop

name: calendar_flip
description: 6 quick calendar page flips, one every 0.16 s; each page slaps at 0.075 + k·0.16 s

name: scoreboard_flip
description: split-flap scoreboard: rattle of 9 plastic flaps, final heavy clack at 0.26 s

name: typewriter_tick
description: single typewriter key strike (per-letter typing)

name: record_scratch
description: vinyl record scratch: four back-and-forth hand strokes over a music groove, stops dead

name: trombone_wah
description: sad muted trombone "wah-wah-wah-waaah" (B♭3 A3 A♭3 G3, last note wobbles and sags)

name: riser_short
description: tension riser: rising filtered noise + tonal sweep + sub swell + reverse-cymbal shimmer with accelerating tremolo; hard cut at 1.40 s, then silence

name: beep_charge
description: three short electronic charge beeps rising C6 → E6 → G6 (0 / 0.28 / 0.56 s) over a faint capacitor-charge whine

name: fanfare_hit
description: [extra · S14 «фанфарный хит»] triumphant brass stab C-major + timpani + crash (cut it with record_scratch)

name: alarm_pulse
description: [extra · E07 «тревожный тон», S31 red pulse] two dark detuned synth pulses (0, 0.5 s) with a faint high warning tone

name: ping_pong
description: [extra · S15 plates flipping «пинг-понг»] two ping-pong ball bounces, left (0) then right (0.28 s)

name: earth_rumble_dirt
description: earth movement / dirt wall rising: low rumble, sliding soil, gravel grit, tumbling rocks and a few heavy thuds

name: dust_puff
description: soft dust puff "pfff": falling air burst, small low whump, fine sand hiss

name: fissure_rip
description: ground tearing open: huge crack at 0, cracks running left → right, roaring gas jet swelling in (0.2–0.9 s), deep rumble with phone-audible harmonics

name: lava_fountain
description: roaring lava fountain: pulsing gas jet, deep rumble, molten splats landing, crackle and hiss

name: water_hose
description: high-pressure water spray: valve burst + sputter at start, hissing jet with turbulence, droplet spatter and splats, low pressure rush

name: steam_hiss_big
description: seawater hitting lava: steam-explosion whump + crackle burst at 0, huge layered hiss and billowing steam roar, frying sizzle, boiling pops

name: sizzle_short
description: short sizzle: "tssst" of water on hot rock with frying crackle and a few pops

name: boat_horn
description: small boat air horn: two toots (0–0.55 s, 0.78–1.65 s), nasal reed tone ≈345 Hz, harbour echo

name: ship_horn_low
description: deep ship horn ≈87 Hz (two horns beating), pitch scoop on attack, natural release, harbour echoes off cliffs

name: boats_engines
description: four small diesel boat engines putt-putting out of the harbour (moving away, slight doppler drop), underwater exhaust burble, bow wash

name: sea_waves
description: calm night sea: small waves lapping on the harbour stones, low swell, distant wash; seamless loop

name: wind_cold
description: Arctic wind: gusting broadband wind with pitched howl that follows the gusts, faint whistle, icy hiss and low buffeting; seamless loop

name: pop_in
description: light cartoon pop for the host appearing: rising bubble "bloop" + tiny sparkle

name: pop_out
description: light cartoon pop for the host leaving: falling "fwup" + air puff

name: explosion_big_el
description: ElevenLabs: massive bomb explosion, crack + deep boom + debris

name: steam_hiss_big_el
description: ElevenLabs: seawater on molten lava, roaring steam hiss + sizzle

name: biplane_flyby_el
description: ElevenLabs: 1930s radial-engine biplane flying low overhead (doppler)

name: bomb_whistle_el
description: ElevenLabs: falling aerial bomb whistle, ends abruptly (hit = end)

name: fissure_rip_el
description: ElevenLabs: ground tearing open, rock cracking, earthquake rumble; loud part 0–1.0 s, then drops away quickly

name: lava_fountain_el
description: ElevenLabs: lava fountain — in practice a deep roaring rumble, almost all energy < 250 Hz (use under the procedural lava_fountain for weight)

name: ship_horn_low_el
description: ElevenLabs: one long deep ship foghorn in a harbour

name: crowd_cheer_short
description: ElevenLabs: small crowd "hooray" with a little applause (no procedural version — synthetic crowds are not convincing)

name: lava_crackle_el
description: ElevenLabs: close-up bubbling, glugging lava with crackling crust

name: boats_engines_el
description: ElevenLabs: several small fishing-boat diesels leaving a harbour
